prescription.effort: Steady-hard (about 6-7 of 10): sustainable, controlled breathing
instructions: Race day: easy warm-up; no strides, as none were done in training
Start controlled; hold steady-hard effort and decide in the final part whether to press
No finish time is promised; effort and how you feel govern the pace
Stop for pain, dizziness or unusual symptoms
Afterwards: easy walking; note how you feel today and tomorrow
